$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the site's backgrounds: one row per pick the header's background menu offers. The row with no scene is the field, the served default; a row with a scene names a library ShaderScene and its tuning for each band BlurBackground paints (home: the tall bands under a hero; page: the standard band under a title). website/src/lib/shaders/background-storage.ts is the accessor and owns the tuning rationale; scripts/validate-site-backgrounds.mjs holds every row to the scenes, their params, their passes and the token registry.
